Porygon2

Normal

Johto · Generation 2

Porygon2 is a Normal-type Virtual Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 32.5 kg. It evolves from Porygon and into Porygon-Z. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (105), with a base stat total of 515.
